d:
The Hawks defeated the Bucks, 113-106 tonight in Milwaukee. CJ McCollum finished with a team-high 20 points along with 4 rebounds and 4 steals for the Hawks, while Nickeil Alexander-Walker tallied 20 points, 5 rebounds and 4 assists in the game. Kasparas Jakučionis recorded 25 points, 5 rebounds and 5 assists. The Hawks improve their record to 8-6 with the win, while the Bucks fall to 1-13 for the season.
